title: Interaction-Aware Embedding Optimization for Neutral-Atom Quantum Processors
summary: Neutral atom-based quantum computers have the ability to dynamically reshape the qubit register geometry between experimental runs. This capability enables different types of problems to be mapped directly onto the hardware, significantly enhancing the efficiency of solving, for instance, complex optimization and machine learning use-cases. However, this flexibility requires finding atom positions to implement target pairwise interactions, inducing a difficult nonconvex optimization for setting up the quantum machine.
